name: Patagonia Environmental Grants: Hong Kong and Macau
summary: Small grants, partly in kind, for grassroots non-profits and fiscally sponsored groups running action-oriented environmental projects in Hong Kong and Macau, including conservation and restoration. Research without an action plan, trail work and land acquisition are excluded.

amount.note: An average range; grants are monetary and non-monetary

eligibility.rule: Has non-profit status or a comparable fiscal sponsor
Does not perpetuate systemic bias or discrimination
No trail work, dam renovations, fish passages, hatcheries, easements, land acquisition or unsupported research
No solely educational projects, environmental conferences, event sponsorships or film festivals
No endowments, political campaigns or green building; bike advocacy must directly support a climate solution
Submits no more than one proposal per group in the fiscal year

status.quote: We accept one proposal per group in this fiscal year (1st April 2026 - 31st March 2027).

applicant_types.quote: organizations without a non-profit status or a comparable fiscal sponsor

geography.quote: takes place within Hong Kong and Macau

access.quote: We accept one proposal per group in this fiscal year (1st April 2026 - 31st March 2027).

amount.quote: ranging from an average of HK$30,000 to HK$80,000

window.quote: All grant proposals that are successfully submitted are reviewed within 1 month.

effort.quote: All grant proposals that are successfully submitted are reviewed within 1 month.

eligibility.quote: organizations without a non-profit status or a comparable fiscal sponsor

organizations that perpetuate systemic biases and discrimination based on ethnicity, race, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, veteran, or disability status

trail creation, maintenance or restoration any dam renovations, human-assisted fish passage infrastructure or hatchery programs conservation easements or land acquisition research, unless it is in direct support of a developed plan for specific action to alleviate an environmental problem
projects that are solely focused on environmental education environmental conferences, event sponsorships or film festivals
endowment funds political campaigns green building projects bike advocacy, unless the project is in direct support of a climate change solution

after_award.quote: If you receive the grant, you will be required to submit a 6-month progress report.
